title: King and pawn: get in front

provenance.authoredBy: Mentor (drafted with AI assistance, positions engine-verified)

steps.title: The king helps the pawn
steps.body: In king and pawn endings the king is the strongest piece. Put your king in front of your pawn, and the enemy king cannot stop it from reaching the end.
White's king is on d6, in front of the pawn on d5. Black's king cannot get in front.

wrong.default: Step the king sideways, not the pawn forward. Keep the king in front.

steps.onSuccess: The king steps aside and the pawn follows, so Black cannot stop it.

steps.why: A king in front clears the way and guards the pawn.

cards.prompt: Where does the king go in a king and pawn ending?
cards.why: It clears the way and cannot be blocked.
